import subprocess, os, sys
BIN='/work/submit/planb64'
def run(args, stdin=None):
    return subprocess.run([BIN]+args,capture_output=True)
def check_build(fibtext, label, expect_ok=False):
    open('/tmp/f.txt','w').write(fibtext)
    if os.path.exists('/tmp/i.idx'): os.remove('/tmp/i.idx')
    r=run(['build','/tmp/f.txt','/tmp/i.idx'])
    ok = (r.returncode==0)
    good = ok==expect_ok and (r.stdout==b'') and ((r.returncode==0) or (r.stderr.startswith(b'ERROR:') and r.stderr))
    if not good:
        print('BUILD CASE FAIL',label,'rc',r.returncode,'out',r.stdout,'err',r.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    if not expect_ok:
        if os.path.exists('/tmp/i.idx'):
            print('dest created on fail',label); sys.exit(1)
    return r

def check_lookup(imgtext, trace, args, expect_ok, label):
    open('/tmp/i2.idx','wb').write(imgtext.encode() if isinstance(imgtext,str) else imgtext)
    open('/tmp/t.txt','w').write(trace)
    r=run(['lookup','/tmp/i2.idx','/tmp/t.txt']+args)
    ok=(r.returncode==0)
    if ok!=expect_ok:
        print('LOOKUP CASE FAIL',label,'rc',r.returncode,'out',r.stdout,'err',r.stderr);sys.exit(1)
    if not ok:
        if r.stdout!=b'' or not r.stderr.startswith(b'ERROR:'):
            print('lookup err format',label,r.stdout,r.stderr);sys.exit(1)

# build errors
check_build('::1/64 5\n::1/64 6\n','dup diff hop')
check_build('::1/64 5\n::/64 5\n','dup same hop')  # both normalize to ::/64
check_build('::/65 5\n','len65')
check_build('::/128 5\n','len128')
check_build('::/0 4294967296\n','hop overflow')
check_build('::/0 5 6\n','extra token')
check_build('::/0 -5\n','sign')
check_build('::/0 +5\n','plus')
check_build('1.2.3.4/24 5\n','ipv4')
check_build('::1%eth0/128 5\n','zone')
check_build('::/0 abc\n','nonnum hop')
check_build('::/0\n','missing hop')
check_build(':: 5\n','no slash')
check_build('', 'empty ok', expect_ok=True)
check_build('\n\n  \t\r\n', 'blank only ok', expect_ok=True)
check_build('  2001:DB8::/32   5  \n','uppercase spaces ok',expect_ok=True)
check_build('::ffff:1.2.3.4/128 5\n','v4embedded ok',expect_ok=True)
# /64 with host bits
check_build('2001:db8::1/64 5\n','host bits ok',expect_ok=True)

# preserve existing dest on failed build
open('/tmp/f.txt','w').write('::/65 5\n')
open('/tmp/keep.idx','w').write('ORIGINAL')
r=run(['build','/tmp/f.txt','/tmp/keep.idx'])
assert r.returncode==2 and open('/tmp/keep.idx').read()=='ORIGINAL', 'dest not preserved'
# don't create new
if os.path.exists('/tmp/new.idx'):os.remove('/tmp/new.idx')
r=run(['build','/tmp/f.txt','/tmp/new.idx'])
assert r.returncode==2 and not os.path.exists('/tmp/new.idx'),'new created'
print('build error cases ok')

# lookup errors: arg forms
goodimg=open('/work/example.idx').read()
open('/tmp/t.txt','w').write('::\n')
for args,exp in [(['scalar'],True),(['batch','3'],True),(['batch','003'],True),(['batch','0'],False),(['batch','257'],False),(['batch',''],False),(['batch','-1'],False),(['batch','3x'],False),(['batch',' 3'],False),(['scalar','x'],False),(['foo'],False)]:
    check_lookup(goodimg,'::\n',args,exp,'args '+str(args))
# missing args
r=run(['lookup','/tmp/i2.idx']); assert r.returncode==2 and r.stderr.startswith(b'ERROR:')
print('lookup arg cases ok')

# malformed images
base=open('/work/example.idx').read()
def bad(img,label):
    check_lookup(img,'::\n',['scalar'],False,label)
bad(base.replace('PLANB64 1','PLANB64 2',1),'header')
bad(base.replace('PLANB64 1','PLANB64  1',1),'header space')
bad('PLANB64 1\n8\n'+'\n'.join(base.split('\n')[2:]),'count mismatch') # duplicate? actually count 8 but rows maybe 8
bad(base.replace('\n8\n','\n7\n',1),'count7')
bad(base.replace('\n8\n','\n9\n',1),'count9')
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000','0000000000000001',1),'first not zero')
bad(base.replace('20010db800000000','20010db800000000'.upper()),'uppercase hex') # none upper; force
# craft uppercase
bad(base.replace('20010db800000000','20010DB800000000',1),'uppercase hex2')
bad(base.replace('20010db800000000','20010db80000000',1),'short hex')
bad(base.replace('20010db800000000','20010db800000000x',1),'long hex')
# unordered
lines=base.split('\n')
# swap two rows
l=base.split('\n')
l[2+1],l[2+2]=l[2+2],l[2+1]
bad('\n'.join(l),'unordered')
# duplicate key adjacent
bad(base.replace('20010db800010000 30 48','20010db800000000 30 48',1),'duplicate keys')
# equal adjacent pair
bad(base.replace('20010db800010000 30 48','20010db800000000 20 32',1),'equal adjacent')
# one-sided no match
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0','0000000000000000 -1 0',1),'onesided1')
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0','0000000000000000 7 -1',1),'onesided2')
# hop out of range
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0','0000000000000000 4294967296 0',1),'hoprange')
# len out of range in matched
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0','0000000000000000 7 65',1),'lenrange')
# leading zero number
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0','0000000000000000 07 0',1),'leadzero')
# no final newline
bad(base.rstrip('\n')+'','no final newline')
# extra record
bad(base+'0000000000000000 1 1\n','extra record')
# double space
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0','0000000000000000  7 0',1),'dbl space')
# leading space
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0',' 0000000000000000 7 0',1),'lead space')
# trailing space
bad(base.replace('0000000000000000 7 0\n','0000000000000000 7 0 \n',1),'trail space')
print('image error cases ok')

# trace errors
for tr,exp in [('::\n1.2.3.4\n',False),('::\n::/64\n',False),('::\n::1%eth0\n',False),(':: extra\n',False),('',True),('\n \t\r\n',True),('::\n2001:DB8::\n',True)]:
    check_lookup(goodimg,tr,['scalar'],exp,'trace '+repr(tr))
print('trace error cases ok')
